subject: Mathematics
topic: What is a set, and two ways to write one
title: Roster Form and Set-builder Form
summary: Two ways to write one set: Roster form lists the elements, Set-builder form states their common property. When to use each.
keyPoints: **Roster form:** list all elements in curly brackets, separated by commas: {a, e, i, o, u}.
In roster form **order does not matter** and **elements are not repeated**: SCHOOL gives {S, C, H, O, L}.
**Set-builder form:** state the common property: {x : x is an even natural number, x ≤ 100}.
Use roster for small sets, set-builder for big or infinite sets.

quiz.q: How many elements are in the set of letters of SCHOOL?
quiz.explain: {S, C, H, O, L}: the repeated O is written once.
Read: the set of all x such that x < 5.

quiz.q: Which form suits the set of all natural numbers?
quiz.explain: An infinite set is described by a property.
